# Nokia SR Linux Cheat Sheet

SR Linux has candidate configuration and operational state. CLI syntax and available paths vary by release; use `?` and completion on the lab image. Substitute the network instance and interface names from the topology.

## Connect and inspect

```sh
docker exec -it clab-LAB-srl sr_cli
```

At the SR Linux CLI:

```text
show version
show interface
show network-instance default route-table ipv4-unicast
show network-instance default protocols bgp neighbor
info from running
```

## Candidate workflow

```text
enter candidate
set interface ethernet-1/1 description lab-link
info interface ethernet-1/1
commit now
```

Inspect the candidate and the impact of a change before committing. A commit changes the running configuration. Remove or change the description using the candidate CLI and commit again; retain the lab source configuration if the container will be recreated.

## Management telemetry

Find the management address with `containerlab inspect -t topology.clab.yml`. The [gNMI lab](../09-lab-workbook/20-gnmi-srlinux.qmd) shows how to query the interface description from a client on the management network. Keep management connectivity separate from data-plane link tests.
